what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Syria, counted by IDMC and UNHCR side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 5963668 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 5542227.
Others left the country: refugees from Syria live mainly in Türkiye, Germany and Lebanon.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria from 2011 to 2025, between the government and Syrian insurgents, at war level from 2011.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2013 to 2025.
Earthquakes, floods, storms and wildfires are the disasters recorded for Syria in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 433000 in 2009 to a peak of 7600000 in 2014.
New displacements from disasters were highest in 2023 in IDMC's records.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 421441 more internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures are never added together.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
